violations.description: Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. The floor under the lobby soda dispenser needs to be cleaned.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Broken wall tile by the drive thru window.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. > Sanitizer buckets were not made while establishment was in operation.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not clean or kept in good repair. > No paper towels were provided in the mens restroom.
Lighting. — --Light intensity for walk-in refrigeration or food storage area was insufficient. > Lighting in the walk in cooler did not work, needed to use flashlights to see walk in.
